records.steps: 1. Check customer_deals limit (5,000 EUR; Head of Sales up to 7,500 EUR by CEO policy). 2. Record the deal with remember(kind=decision, topic=customer_deals). 3. Above the limit the Steward escalates to the CEO: tell the customer the offer is pending.
1. Call remember(kind=task) with what is done and what is left. 2. If it moves a date, say which date: the Steward will ask the product lead.
1. Check marketing_spend limit (10,000 EUR per commitment; trade shows up to 12,000 EUR by CEO policy). 2. remember(kind=decision, topic=marketing_spend) with the amount in EUR.
